description.narrative: IFC has invested an amount of US$100 million in L&T Finance Limited (LTF or the Company). The financing package would comprise of a senior, secured, US$ denominated loan with a tenor of up to 3 years. IFCs loan proceeds will be deployed towards the following segments: (i) At least 40% for on-lending to women microentrepreneurs or self-employed women borrowers, for income generation purposes, with a maximum ticket size of US$10,000; (ii) At least 50% for financing the purchase of two-wheeler (2W) vehicles by microentrepreneurs or self-employed borrowers; of which at least 75% of the proceeds will be provided to women borrowers and (iii) At least 10% for financing the purchase of electric vehicles (EVs) by individuals. Additionally, at least 50% of IFCs loan proceeds will be deployed towards lending in rural areas.

Stakeholder effects: Increased access to finance for microenterprises and self-employed borrowers, including women borrowers: IFC anticipates that the proposed investment will support the Company in growing its micro-loans portfolio and increase access to finance for microenterprises and self-employed borrowers, including women borrowers.
Market effects: Competitiveness: IFC anticipates the Project, coupled with IFCs other systematic interventions in the MSME segment, will help promote greater competitiveness by demonstrating the potential of scaling up financing to microenterprises and women borrowers, and encouraging other FIs to grow their micro loan portfolios.
